concepts.title: Django Basics and Setup
concepts.description: Learn Django framework fundamentals and project setup

teachingContent.beginner:
**Django** is a high-level Python web framework for building web applications quickly.

**Installing Django:**
```bash
pip install django
```

**Creating a Project:**
```bash
django-admin startproject myproject
cd myproject
python manage.py runserver
```

**Project Structure:**
```
myproject/
├── manage.py          # Command-line utility
├── myproject/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── settings.py    # Configuration
│   ├── urls.py        # URL routing
│   └── wsgi.py        # Deployment
```

**Key Concepts:**
- **MVT Pattern**: Model-View-Template
- **Apps**: Modular components
- **ORM**: Database abstraction
teachingContent.intermediate:
Django follows the MVT (Model-View-Template) pattern:

**Creating an App:**
```bash
python manage.py startapp blog
```

**Register App in settings.py:**
```python
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    'django.contrib.admin',
    'django.contrib.auth',
    # ...
    'blog',  # Your app
]
```

**Django Architecture:**
- **Models**: Database structure
- **Views**: Business logic
- **Templates**: HTML presentation
- **URLs**: Route mapping
teachingContent.advanced:
Understanding Django's request-response cycle:

**Request Flow:**
```
Browser → URLs → View → Model → Database
                    ↓
                Template → Response → Browser
```

**Settings Configuration:**
```python
# settings.py
DEBUG = False  # Production
ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['yourdomain.com']
DATABASES = {
    'default': {
        'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.postgresql',
        'NAME': 'mydb',
    }
}
```

concepts.title: Models and Database
concepts.description: Learn to define models and work with Django ORM

teachingContent.beginner:
**Models** define your database structure using Python classes.

**Creating a Model:**
```python
from django.db import models

class Post(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    content = models.TextField()
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    
    def __str__(self):
        return self.title
```

**Migrations:**
```bash
python manage.py makemigrations  # Create migration files
python manage.py migrate         # Apply to database
```

**Common Field Types:**
- `CharField`: Short text
- `TextField`: Long text
- `IntegerField`: Numbers
- `DateTimeField`: Date and time
- `BooleanField`: True/False
teachingContent.intermediate:
Django ORM for database operations:

**Creating Records:**
```python
# Create and save
post = Post(title='Hello', content='World')
post.save()

# Or use create()
Post.objects.create(title='Hello', content='World')
```

**Querying:**
```python
# Get all
all_posts = Post.objects.all()

# Filter
recent = Post.objects.filter(created_at__gte='2024-01-01')

# Get one
post = Post.objects.get(id=1)
```

**Relationships:**
```python
class Comment(models.Model):
    post = models.ForeignKey(Post, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    text = models.TextField()
```
teachingContent.advanced:
Advanced ORM queries and optimization:

**Complex Queries:**
```python
from django.db.models import Q, Count

# OR queries
Post.objects.filter(Q(title__contains='Django') | Q(content__contains='Python'))

# Aggregation
Post.objects.aggregate(Count('id'))

# Prefetch related (avoid N+1)
Post.objects.prefetch_related('comments')
```

**Custom Managers:**
```python
class PublishedManager(models.Manager):
    def get_queryset(self):
        return super().get_queryset().filter(status='published')

class Post(models.Model):
    # ...
    objects = models.Manager()
    published = PublishedManager()
```

concepts.title: Views and URLs
concepts.description: Learn to create views and map URLs

teachingContent.beginner:
**Views** handle requests and return responses.

**Function-Based View:**
```python
from django.http import HttpResponse

def home(request):
    return HttpResponse('Hello, Django!')
```

**URL Configuration (urls.py):**
```python
from django.urls import path
from . import views

urlpatterns = [
    path('', views.home, name='home'),
    path('about/', views.about, name='about'),
]
```

**Rendering Templates:**
```python
from django.shortcuts import render

def home(request):
    return render(request, 'home.html', {'title': 'Home'})
```
teachingContent.intermediate:
Advanced view patterns:

**Class-Based Views:**
```python
from django.views import View
from django.views.generic import ListView

class PostListView(ListView):
    model = Post
    template_name = 'posts.html'
    context_object_name = 'posts'
```

**URL Parameters:**
```python
# urls.py
path('post/<int:pk>/', views.post_detail, name='post_detail')

# views.py
def post_detail(request, pk):
    post = Post.objects.get(pk=pk)
    return render(request, 'post.html', {'post': post})
```
teachingContent.advanced:
Advanced view patterns and mixins:

**Generic Views:**
```python
from django.views.generic import (
    ListView, DetailView, CreateView, UpdateView, DeleteView
)

class PostCreateView(CreateView):
    model = Post
    fields = ['title', 'content']
    success_url = '/posts/'
```

**Mixins:**
```python
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin

class PostCreateView(LoginRequiredMixin, CreateView):
    model = Post
    fields = ['title', 'content']
```

concepts.title: Templates
concepts.description: Learn Django template language and rendering

teachingContent.beginner:
**Templates** are HTML files with Django template language. **Basic Template (home.html):** ```html {{ title }}

Welcome, {{ user.username }}!

{{ content }}

``` **Template Variables:** ```html {{ variable }} {{ user.username }} {{ items.0 }} ``` **Template Tags:** ```html {% if user.is_authenticated %}

Hello, {{ user.username }}

{% else %}

Please log in

{% endif %} ```
teachingContent.intermediate:
Template inheritance and loops: **Base Template (base.html):** ```html {% block title %}My Site{% endblock %} {% block content %}{% endblock %} ``` **Child Template:** ```html {% extends 'base.html' %} {% block title %}Home{% endblock %} {% block content %}

Welcome!

{% endblock %} ``` **Loops:** ```html {% for post in posts %}

{{ post.title }}

{{ post.content }}

{% endfor %} ```
teachingContent.advanced:
Advanced template features:

**Template Filters:**
```html
{{ text|lower }}              <!-- Lowercase -->
{{ date|date:"Y-m-d" }}       <!-- Format date -->
{{ content|truncatewords:30 }} <!-- Truncate -->
```

**Custom Template Tags:**
```python
from django import template

register = template.Library()

@register.filter
def custom_filter(value):
    return value.upper()
```

concepts.title: Forms and Authentication
concepts.description: Learn to handle forms and user authentication

teachingContent.beginner:
**Forms** handle user input in Django.

**Creating a Form:**
```python
from django import forms

class ContactForm(forms.Form):
    name = forms.CharField(max_length=100)
    email = forms.EmailField()
    message = forms.CharField(widget=forms.Textarea)
```

**Using in View:**
```python
def contact(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = ContactForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            # Process form
            name = form.cleaned_data['name']
    else:
        form = ContactForm()
    return render(request, 'contact.html', {'form': form})
```

**Template:**
```html
<form method="post">
    {% csrf_token %}
    {{ form.as_p }}
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
```
